items.title: Tesla’s Cybertruck Is Dying
items.summary: Elon Musk promised the most unique thing on the road, a truck built to take on the F-150. Tesla's plans now point toward humanoid robots, and Ford's own electric flagship offers a warning about what buyers really want.

items.title: RIP Cybertruck. Musk Says Tesla Winding Down Production Months After It Was Called The “Biggest Flop In Automotive History”
